title: Cross-repository integration readiness
description: Help agents check declared interfaces and compatibility before connecting PhiOS ecosystem modules.
knowledge: Map dependencies from actual manifest and API contracts, never inferred repository-name similarity alone.
Identify contract versions, caller/callee roles, authentication boundaries, and consent requirements.
Test compatibility against pinned commits with a minimal fixture, then record observed pass/fail evidence.
Propose integration changes for review; repository observation itself must not grant write or merge authority.
